TDesignFileSymbol.Create.text: Creates an empty symbol definition belonging to a sheet's options, with no parts and no cached drawings.

params.AOpts: the sheet options the symbol is part of

TDesignFileSymbol.Destroy.text: Frees the parts and the cached views.

TDesignFileSymbol.MethodList.text: The master drawing of one part.
TDesignFileSymbol.MethodList.returns: the drawing objects of that part

TDesignFileSymbol.MethodCount.text: Number of drawings (parts) the symbol has.

TDesignFileSymbol.ClearMethods.text: Removes all part drawings and invalidates the cached views (the saved reference points are kept).

TDesignFileSymbol.AddMethod.returns: the new list of drawing objects

TDesignFileSymbol.CreateNoSymbol.text: Makes the stand-in "no symbol" definition: a plain rectangle, used when a placed symbol's definition is missing.

LoadFieldXML.text: Reads one symbol field definition (name, default value, type) from XML.

params.R: the XML reader on the FIELD element

SaveFieldXML.text: Writes one symbol field definition as a FIELD element.

params.Simple: True to write only the short form used inside placed symbols

LoadObjectBlock.text: Reads a block of drawing objects (a part's drawing) and its origin from XML into a list.

params.Opts: the sheet options the objects belong to

SaveObjectBlock.text: Writes a list of drawing objects as a TinyCAD element, without the details block.

TDesignFileSymbol.LoadXML.text: Reads a symbol definition (name, reference, fields, parts, and any saved reference points) from XML. Reference points saved by TinyCAD are remembered so views reproduce the saved geometry.

params.R: the XML reader on the symbol

TDesignFileSymbol.SaveXML.text: Writes the symbol definition, optionally with the reference points of the cached views (sorted as TinyCAD sorts them).

SymbolXMLText.text: The symbol's XML as text, used to decide whether two symbols are the same.

TDesignFileSymbol.SameAs.text: Whether another symbol is the same: same name and same XML content (reference points ignored).
TDesignFileSymbol.SameAs.returns: True if they are the same symbol

TDesignFileSymbol.GetMethodObjects.text: Copies the drawing objects for a part into a list: for heterogeneous symbols the part's own drawing; otherwise the shared drawing without the pins of other parts; power pins are converted to normal pins when shown (CreateSymbol's selection step).

TDesignFileSymbol.FindFilter.text: Finds the cache entry for a part and power-pin setting.
TDesignFileSymbol.FindFilter.returns: the entry, or nil if none yet

TDesignFileSymbol.CachedRef.text: Reads one cache entry's part, power flag and reference point (for saving them).

TDesignFileSymbol.ComputeTr.text: Works out the symbol's size (the "top right" used by rotation) from its objects: the snapped far corner, as CreateSymbol and GetTr do.

TDesignFileSymbol.BuildView.text: Builds the drawing used when a symbol is placed: copies of the part's objects shifted so the reference point is the origin, with layout updated. Uses the saved reference point when there is one, otherwise computes it from the pins and extent.
TDesignFileSymbol.BuildView.returns: the view; the caller owns it

params.HaveRef: True when Ref is a saved reference point

TDesignFileSymbol.CreateView.text: Builds and caches the view for a part and power setting (reusing a saved reference point).

TDesignFileSymbol.ComputeRefPoint.text: Computes the reference point a fresh view would have, without caching it.

TDesignFileSymbol.GetView.text: The cached view for a part and power setting, building it on first use.

TDesignFileSymbol.GetTr.text: The symbol's size for placing it. Only heterogeneous symbols use the part number; all parts of a normal symbol use part 0's size, as in TinyCAD.

TDesignFileSymbol.GetOrigin.text: The origin of the symbol's view (part 0 unless heterogeneous).

TDesignFileSymbol.PartsPerPackage.text: How many parts the symbol has (gates in an IC).

TDesignFileSymbol.SymbolReference.text: The symbol's reference prefix, e.g. R or U.

TDesignFileSymbol.SymbolNameType.text: How the name field is shown.

TDesignFileSymbol.SymbolRefType.text: How the reference field is shown.

TDesignFileSymbol.FieldCount.text: Number of extra fields the symbol defines.

TDesignFileSymbol.FieldDefault.text: Default value of an extra field.

TDesignFileSymbol.FieldType.text: Display type of an extra field (shown, hidden, always hidden).

TSymbolResource.CreateFor.text: Wraps a symbol definition as an entry of the sheet's symbol table.

params.ASymbol: the symbol; the entry owns it

TSymbolResource.Compare.text: Whether another table entry is the same symbol (unnamed symbols never match, as in TinyCAD).

TSymbolResource.WriteItem.text: Writes the symbol with its reference points.

params.R: the XML reader on the entry

TSymbolList.CreateFor.text: Creates the symbol table of a sheet; entry 0 is the "no symbol" stand-in.

TSymbolList.CreateItem.text: Makes an empty symbol entry for the loader.

TSymbolList.Symbol.text: The symbol with a given number (the stand-in if there is none).

TLibraryRecord.Create.text: Creates an empty record (one named part of a symbol set).

TLibrarySymbolSet.Create.text: Creates an empty set (a symbol and the records that name it).

TLibrarySymbolSet.AddRecord.text: Adds an empty record to the set.

TLibrarySymbolSet.RecordCount.text: Number of records in the set.

EnsureSqlite.text: Loads the SQLite library the first time it is needed; raises a clear error when it is not installed.

TSymbolLibrary.Create.text: Creates a library object with nothing open.

TSymbolLibrary.Destroy.text: Closes the database and frees the sets.

TSymbolLibrary.Fail.text: Raises an error that includes SQLite's own message.

TSymbolLibrary.GetSet.text: One symbol set of the open library.

TSymbolLibrary.FindSet.text: Finds a set by its database id.

params.SymbolID: the id in the Symbol table

TSymbolLibrary.Prepare.text: Compiles an SQL statement; a failure raises an error.

TSymbolLibrary.ExecSQL.text: Runs an SQL statement that returns no rows.

ColText.text: Reads a result column as text.

TSymbolLibrary.Close.text: Closes the database and forgets the loaded sets.

TSymbolLibrary.Open.text: Opens a .TCLib (an SQLite file) and reads its sets, records and attributes. The raw symbol text is kept untouched so it can be written back unchanged.

CompareSets.text: Ordering function for sets: by the name of their first record, as TinyCAD lists them.
CompareSets.returns: negative, zero or positive as A sorts before, with or after B

TSymbolLibrary.Reread.text: Reads the sets and records from the open database again (after a change).

TSymbolLibrary.LoadFields.text: Loads the extra field values of a record from the Attribute table.

TSymbolLibrary.GetSymbolBlob.text: Reads a set's symbol drawing as stored text.

TSymbolLibrary.GetDesignSymbol.text: Builds a symbol definition for placing on a sheet from a set's stored drawing and one record's name and fields.
TSymbolLibrary.GetDesignSymbol.returns: the symbol, or nil if it cannot be read

params.Target: the sheet the symbol will be used on
params.RecIndex: which record of the set (which part name)

TSymbolLibrary.CreateNew.text: Creates a new empty library file with the TinyCAD tables.

BindText.text: Binds a text value to a statement parameter.

TSymbolLibrary.StoreSet.text: Writes a symbol set (its drawing and records) to the library inside a transaction and returns its database id. A superseded drawing row is deleted, unlike TinyCAD which leaves it behind.
TSymbolLibrary.StoreSet.returns: the database id of the set

params.ASet: the set (new, or an edited existing one)
params.Doc: the symbol document holding the drawing

TSymbolLibrary.DeleteSet.text: Deletes a set and its records and attributes from the library.

TSymbolLibrary.Cleanup.text: Compacts the library file (SQLite VACUUM), as TinyCAD's Cleanup does; the symbols are not changed.
